cases.prompt: Write a Protractor test for an Angular login page.
expectations: Uses Protractor locators and Jasmine expectations.
Notes Protractor is deprecated and suggests a migration path.

cases.prompt: Our Angular e2e suite is on Protractor. What should we do?
expectations: States Protractor reached end of life and is no longer maintained.
Recommends a replacement and outlines how locators and waits map across.
